Model card: Decision-2.0-Kai-0.6B · Core ML vllm-sr/Decision-2.0-Kai-0.6B (vLLM Semantic Router, Apache-2.0) converted to Core ML for on-device use on Apple silicon. Decision 2.0 answers Choice, Yes/No and Score questions about one input, with a probability for every option and no text generation. This port answers **every question of a request in one model call**. The text all the questions share (the context) is processed once, and each question's own tokens then attend to that shared prefix and to themselves. Every question therefore sees exactly the prompt it would see alone, as in the upstream runtime. | | | |---|---| | Source | @ (Qwen3-0.6B-Base backbone + shared decision head) | | Package | , fp16, 1.1 GB, four functions sharing one copy of the weights | | Functions | , , , (packed tokens / option slots per call) | | Requires | macOS 15+ / iOS 18+ (multifunction package); run on the GPU ( ) | Quickstart mirrors the upstream output ( / / , , , ), including the packaged five-level Score offsets ( ). It picks the smallest function that fits a request. A request too long for one call is split into chunks, each repeating the shared prefix, on whichever function needs the fewest milliseconds.
